text:
Jordan: Heads-up: hitting a couple repeating SEVs where postmortem follow-ups went stale. proposing a 'fastlane' postmortem follow-up to tighten ownership and visibility. sketch: 48h owner-ack, 72h status, 10d remediation sprint, 6w recurrence window.
Sam: sounds promising. why faster than our usual 72h start?
Jordan: goal is to force earlier engagement on high-impact incidents so blockers surface quickly. plan is severity-based cadence: high -> fastlane, med/low -> standard cadence.
Lina: add a mandatory owner ack inside 48h so we know someone saw it. require owner to state impact (low/med/high) and an ETA (hours) in the ack.
Raj: rotation suggestion: default IC rotation is 1 week. for big cross-team incidents allow a 2-week IC with explicit handover note on week 2. always include IC on the postmortem root so follow-ups know who to ping.
oncall-bot: reminder scheduled: 72h status ping set for thread 1940124000.
Sam: can we standardize the T+72h message so our dashboards can parse it? example: "Status: <on-track|blocked>. PR: <link>. ETA: <days>. Blockers: <short>"
Lina: +1. also request a Jira label pm-followup and a custom field "remediation-owner" so reports and boards surface remediations cleanly.
Jordan: comms cadence proposal: engineer channels get owner-ack (T+48h), T+72h brief, T+10d closure note. Execs get a weekly summary email until closure when severity is high.
PM: for a pilot, run this fastlane on next 8 incidents split by severity (4 high, 4 med). measure: % with owner assigned within 48h, % closed by 10d, recurrence within 6w.
Raj: automation asks: oncall-bot should create a minimal checklist in the action tracker at T+0, ping owner at 48h and 72h, and schedule a regression-replay job at T+42d to surface repeats.
Sam: I'll update the incident templates to include owner-ack and paste the suggested snippet.
Jordan: I'll draft the fastlane doc and add the compact template + checklist link: https://docs.internal/redwood/fastlane-followup. reconvene after the pilot to compare outcomes vs. our standard 72h cadence. :white_check_mark:
